instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. In a modern cafe with a large beige arched partition, the woman in the beige blazer and blue bandana (R1) sits on the left, gesturing with her hands closer together as she speaks. On the right, the woman in the pink corduroy blazer and glasses (R2) sits in a wheelchair, listening with a gentle smile and her hands in her lap. They sit opposite each other at a small black table with a coffee cup. Warm, natural daylight illuminates the scene, creating soft shadows and a relaxed, conversational atmosphere.
